# Dr. David M. Beyer

**Professor of Mushrooms**
Department of Plant Pathology and Environmental Microbiology
Director of the Mushroom Research Center
The Pennsylvania State University

* [Penn State profile](https://plantpath.psu.edu/directory/dmb8)

---

## Biography

Dr. David M. Beyer is Professor of Mushrooms in the Department of Plant Pathology and Environmental Microbiology at Penn State University. His research and extension programs address the full mushroom-production system, from composting and substrate preparation through crop production, nutrition, physiology, integrated pest management, and disease control.

Before entering academia, Dr. Beyer worked in commercial mushroom production at Leaver Mushrooms in Ontario, Canada, beginning in 1979 and later serving as Director of Growing. He subsequently completed graduate training in plant pathology at Penn State. His program connects applied research with grower education and industry outreach across the North American mushroom sector.

---
## Collaborations

Dr. Beyer collaborates with the Briseño Lab on cultivated-mushroom health, mycovirus detection, virome ecology, disease diagnostics, and the biological effects of virus infections in *Agaricus bisporus*.

---
## Funding

Dr. Beyer has led and participated in USDA-funded research and extension projects focused on mushroom pest management, disease control, organic production, crop profitability, and industry education.
